submittedParameters.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit input1 only in hands and props. Preserve every other part: head hair crown torso shoulders sleeves hips both legs both shoes, pose, exact full-canvas registration, scale, palette, transparent background. Inputs2 portrait identity,3NE idle direction,4approvedpaint style. NE rear view away toward upper-right. Anatomical RIGHT arm is attached to SCREEN RIGHT SHOULDER; it must end in a RIGHT hand holding FIVE red/gold talisman cards. Anatomical LEFT arm is attached to SCREEN LEFT SHOULDER; it must end in LEFT hand holding one bronze bell with red tassel. Exactly five cards, five outer corners, five flame panels, no hidden sixth red sliver. Current props are assigned to the WRONG hands. Locally repaint the prop and grasp at each wrist: replace the screen-LEFT fan with bronze bell and red tassel attached to the existing screen-left wrist, replace the screen-RIGHT bell with a five-card fan held by existing screen-right wrist. Do NOT exchange shoulders, do NOT mirror body, do NOT turn torso, do NOT change either sleeve position. Secure visible fingers appropriate to each grasp. Keep pose, ankles, shoe directions and contact exactly unchanged in this edit. Single native square >=1024 RGBA, true transparency. No shadows floor scene glow particles labels or grid.
